title: Legal Entity Subunit Role Delegation vLEI Credential
description: A vLEI Credential issued to delegate authority from a LegalEntitySubunitRolevLEICredential to another Legal Entity or Subunit

i.description: Delegate AID - the entity receiving delegated authority

delegatorLEI.description: LEI of the delegating legal entity

delegateLEI.description: LEI of the delegate (required if delegate is a legal entity, optional if subunit)

policyDomain.description: The policy domain - must match the source credential exactly

endorsementCode.description: The endorsement code - must match the source credential exactly

canRedelegate.description: If true, delegate may further delegate authority; if false, this is a terminal delegation

oneOf.description: Edges block for initial delegation from LESR holder

role.description: Chain to Legal Entity Subunit Role vLEI Credential

n.description: SAID of the ACDC to which the edge connects

s.description: SAID of required schema of the credential pointed to by this node

o.description: Operator indicating this node is the issuer

oneOf.description: Edges block for re-delegation from another delegation credential

delegation.description: Chain to parent Legal Entity Subunit Role Delegation vLEI Credential

n.description: SAID of the ACDC to which the edge connects

s.description: SAID of required schema of the credential pointed to by this node (self-referential)

o.description: Operator indicating this node is the issuer

l.const: This delegation credential conveys authority derived from a Legal Entity Subunit Role vLEI Credential. The delegate is authorized to act within the scope defined by the policyDomain and endorsementCode attributes, which must exactly match those of the source credential. If canRedelegate is false, this credential represents terminal authority that cannot be further delegated. All delegations in the chain must be valid, unexpired, and non-revoked for this credential to be considered valid.

Usage of a valid, unexpired, and non-revoked vLEI Credential, as defined in the associated Ecosystem Governance Framework, does not assert that the Legal Entity is trustworthy, honest, reputable in its business dealings, safe to do business with, or compliant with any laws or that an implied or expressly intended purpose will be fulfilled.

All information in a valid, unexpired, and non-revoked vLEI Credential, as defined in the associated Ecosystem Governance Framework, is accurate as of the date the validation process was complete. The vLEI Credential has been issued to the legal entity or person named in the vLEI Credential as the subject; and the qualified vLEI Issuer exercised reasonable care to perform the validation process set forth in the vLEI Ecosystem Governance Framework.

Privacy Considerations are applicable to Legal Entity Subunit Role Delegation vLEI Credentials. It is the sole responsibility of Issuees of these Credentials to present them in a privacy-preserving manner using the mechanisms provided in the Issuance and Presentation Exchange (IPEX) protocol specification and the Authentic Chained Data Container (ACDC) specification. https://github.com/WebOfTrust/IETF-IPEX and https://github.com/trustoverip/tswg-acdc-specification.
